digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / rich text codec
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes its dedup key's two sides (local vs. Jira-fetched) using different decode compositions: local side applies markdown round-trip escaping via AdfCodec.normalize_outbound, while Jira side applies adf_to_text without escaping, causing identical markdown bodies to mismatch

The local dedup key computation passes the undecorated comment body through a markdown round trip (adf_to_markdown(markdown_to_adf(...))), but the actual send path encodes the decorated body with an HTML comment, which triggers markdown_to_adf's fallback degradation to plain text, creating a wire-to-local mismatch

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact wire produced by the send path (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry
Markdown comments within length limits are incorrectly re-emitted as duplicate mutations because their dedup keys diverge despite matching landed bodies
The truncation notice is similarly markdown-escaped on local side only, visible as asymmetry between `\[truncated by reconciler\]` and `[truncated by reconciler]`
